rev.t: This store is an absolute gold. It doesn't have the wide array of collections offered by the Church Street bookstores, but you can find a sweet shopkeeper and unique books at a fifth of the price. Sometimes used, sometimes new, sometimes pirated, but the quality of the books are a constant A+
